text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Digital! Today's the day I finally 
make you cry uncle~~!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Eeep?! S-Sudden close approach from my 
idol~! What is this?! *drools*☆)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh~! I came up with a super special 
prank for today~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hear this and be amazed~! Starting right 
now, I'm going to 'ignore' you!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Since you'd be happy no matter what I do, 
I'm not gonna do a single thing for 
youuu~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Eeeek! Out of nowhere, she literally just 
walked up to declare she's giving me the 
cold shoulder! And she went out of her way 
just to say that~?!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah, um, what does that mean...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heheheh! You are suffering, aren't you...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oof! Excuse me, I'm drooling...! *Phaant, 
phaant*...! Heheh, hehehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Why are you laughing!? Cut it out, I 
say~~!!
